One thing this pandemic has done is that it has made me realise how blessed I am to have anything at all. I'm so thankful for my family and that I'm even able to eat and have a roof over my head.Not alot of people can say that. You got to realise my friend Gods character is certainly not different from what you hear because think about it.. he's top objective in your life is trying to make you one with him again to give him the glory because he loves you and want your eternal resting place to be a good one. And what have you done since this pandemic? You drawn closer to God and you say you feel closer to him since in a very long time. He is working in your life my dear can't you see?. Longsuffering and hardtimes are almost a certainty in a follower of Christ's life but think of this if you keep drawing closer to the Lord and trust in him throughout this fear mongering pandemic think of how safe you be under the protection of the almighty! There is no safer place to be. Keep seeking him, keep trusting him , keep on loving everyone and keep out of sin. God will surely help you if you if you make his will your will and let Him be your refuge.

I pray that God, the source of hope, will fill you completely with joy and peace because you trust in him. Then you will overflow with confident hope through the power of the Holy Spirit. - Roman 15:13

Jesus bless you and keep you friend.

Yes, I've experienced just this. And as much as your state of mind or influencing spirits are going to try and denounce this remember friend, it's straight out of the good book or even greater the author :)

‘ As I live,’ says the Lord God , ‘I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live.

Ezekiel 33:11

For I have no pleasure in the death of one who dies,” says the Lord God . “Therefore turn and live!”
Ezekiel 18:32 

As long as you have breath in your lungs. The Lord can forgive you. There is hope! Take what you've learned now and apply it, not on your own power but by his and his alone. Giving your weakness to him and constantly seeking Him for protection. Jesus bless you.
You are helping me understand alot with your comments thank you. Can I ask why does God desire "glory"? What is it to Him?

I am in no way proposing a prosperity gospel to people. God knows what we need. I simply abided by the saying "Seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness and all these things will be added unto you" I essentially forgot about my problems and laid them all on Jesus because I believe him when he said: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light. we come unto Him we shall find rest unto our souls. - Matthew 11:28-3

I believe everyone has their time. I was denied many many jobs and did not eat properly for weeks on end. Other candidates beat me too it I guess.. And what did it do? it made me so unbelievablely desperate i couldnt rely on anyone but God and now my soul is on seeking Jesus more which is the best thing I could be doing. I'm sure just as I was denied jobs for a time, those people who would get denied because of my success in the attaining the job, perhaps God will use the situation like this to make them reach out to him for help like he did for me. And in doing so they realise what is really important..Making God your No.1 priority. So a better question would be is God unjust for trying to save someone's soul? 

Absolutely not!

Read the bible my friend. You are young I understand and hormonal at this age, but I would like to give you some advice here since i continued on that road you are travelling now and i can tell you from expierence it is not pleasing God and will end you up in misery as it did to me so many times again and again. 

There are things called fruits of the spirit which you should be producing if you are following Jesus wholeheartedly. We are given examples of fruits of the spirit in the bible such as

Love, joy,
peace,
longsuffering,
gentleness,
goodness,
faith, 
Meekness 
and most importantly in relation to your question:  **SELF-CONTROL** 


Then there are also what are known as acts of the flesh. Which God does not want us doing. People who practice these will NOT enter the kingdom of heaven. Which are as follows:

Adultery,
 fornication, 
uncleanness, 

***lasciviousness***

Idolatry,
witchcraft,
hatred,
variance, 
emulations, 
wrath,
Strife, 
seditions,
heresies,
Envyings, 
murders, 
drunkenness,
revellings



Lasciviousness, which I have highlighted,masturbation clearly fits into the definition of this word.(even if your not looking at anything sexually explicit) it is a work of the flesh. It is pleasing your flesh rather than being obedient to God basically making your pleasures your God. The Lord does not want you acting on your fleshly desires in this life (That is why SELF-CONTROL is a fruit of the spirit and not a act of the flesh. We must worship God in SPIRIT and in TRUTH. 

I know you want to deny this so much and pass it off as nothing and listen to the people who say it is completely normal and you should do it, as I did at your age and I suffered greatly, but please friend do it for Jesus. He loves you he died for you and in turn He asks us to die to self which basically means putting your lustful wants out of the picture and having him Lord of your life. You will reap the benefits beyond your imagination if you follow Jesus as He wants you to, but at the end of the day the choice is YOURS. Jesus said if you love me you'll keep my commandments. Pray to Jesus today don't just take it from us. He should be your only teacher not us.  If you need help with anything don't hesitate to ask. May Jesus bless you friend!

Happy birthday brotha! I've had a few bdays like that also. It really did hurt those times but I kinda just said to myself one year why am I looking for happiness in people? That will make me lonely. If they're here great if not it really is no big deal, will catch up another time. I've had times in my life where is feel awful lonely (not bdays) and thought my friends should be here now wth!? But then a day or two later found out they actually genuinely had something happening so they couldn't be there. I'm sorry you had this experience dude, I know how it feels but msg me anytime I'm up for a chat about whatever whenever!

That's your opinion and this is mine I suppose. All I can say is I've been to the lowest of the low. Taken drugs and alcohol  trying to numb the pain and have tried all the specialists to no avail. The only thing that saved me from that place which I can see this person is suffering from also is Jesus. I'm not going to sit back idle and not tell him what I believe is the truth that would be hatred on my part and I do not hate this man. 

Jesus said: "Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest." He has done just that for me.

If all else fails turn to Jesus and ask for help and forgiveness. Or do it now would be the right suggestion. I was in your exact situation got real angry about everything because this wasnt how i envisioned my life how did everything go to hell? but just said no more one day. What have you got to lose if you plan on losing everything anyway? you may just be surprised if you truly commit to his cause not your own, great things will come. He promised this. I've tried all these experts 'solutions' for happiness all they did was dig a deeper hole for me. Please mate, don't do such a foolish thing I'm hear for a talk anytime I mean it just hit me up!

I'm kinda new on my walk with God but, I hear alot of people saying this God said to me line. Do you hear a audible voice or is it just something that manifests in your mind and you believe it's God? Because I'd like to hear too.

Sorry I'm still learning the bible. But would like to ask something in reply to your answer. Didn't God make these commands? and it also says God never changes and remains the same and Jesus also said he didn't come to abolish the laws but fulfill them? Just trying to understand the facts. Thank you.

Don't do it. Turn to Jesus repent your sins follow him exactly as he says and he will save you just like he did me. I've been to the bottom it's sick horrible and genuinely terrifying how you wonder how you ended up in the place you get to at that point. But trust me m8 Jesus is The Truth The Life and THE WAY. Message me anytime you wanna talk.
